data.name: Obaidah
data.gender_notes: Obaidah is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who serves, one who is a servant or helper. The name Obaidah carries the meaning “Servant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Obaidah usually hope their child will grow to embody servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who are devoted to serving Allah and helping others.
data.etymology: Obaidah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Obaidah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: عبيدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي معناه العبد أو الخادم
in_arabic.long_meaning: عبيدة هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من كلمة 'عبد' التي تعني العبد أو الخادم. هذا الاسم يحمل دلالة عميقة على التواضع والخضوع لله تعالى. وقد ورد ذكر اسم 'عبد' في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، مما يعطي الاسم قيمة روحية ودينية كبيرة. يستخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كتسمية للمولود الذكر، تعبيرًا عن رغبة الأهل في أن يكون ابنهم متواضعًا وملتزمًا بقيم الإسلام.

in_urdu.name: عبدہ
in_urdu.meaning: عبد یا خادم کے معنی میں ایک مذکر نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: عبدہ ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے عبد یا خادم۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کی عبادت اور تواضع کی دلالت کرتا ہے۔ عربی میں 'عبد' کی جڑ سے نکلا ہوا، یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی معاشرے میں، یہ نام اکثر ایسے بچوں کے لیے منتخب کیا جاتا ہے جن کی پرورش میں تواضع اور دینی اقدار کو महत्व দেও گیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: उबैदा
in_hindi.meaning: उबैदा का अर्थ है सेवक या दास
in_hindi.long_meaning: उबैदा एक पुरुष नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है सेवक या दास। यह नाम अल्लाह की सेवा और विनम्रता की भावना को दर्शाता है। अरबी मूल 'अब्द' से व्युत्पन्न, यह नाम इस्लामी परंपरा में गहरी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम अक्सर उन बच्चों के लिए चुना जाता है जिनकी परवरिश में विनम्रता और धार्मिक मूल्यों को महत्व दिया जाता है।

in_pashto.name: عبيدہ
in_pashto.meaning: د بندګۍ یا خدمت معنا لرونکی مذکر نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: عبيدہ يو مذکر نوم دی چی د عربي ژبی څخه اخیستل شوی دی. دے مطلب دی بندګ یا خدمتګار. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د عبادت او تواضع دلالت کوي. د عربي په 'عبد' کښې ريښه درلوده، دا نوم د افغان او پښتن مسلمانانو په دودونو کښې مهم روحاني معنا لري. په افغانستان او پاکستان کې، دا نوم ډیری وخت داسې ماشومانو لپاره غوره کیږي کوم چې د تواضع او مذهبي ارزښتونو په پالنه کې لوی شوي دي.

in_english.name: Obaidah
in_english.meaning: Servant or worshiper, derived from Arabic root 'abd'
in_english.long_meaning: Obaidah is a masculine given name originating from Arabic. It is derived from the root 'abd', meaning servant or worshiper. This name carries a profound spiritual significance, symbolizing humility and submission to God. Referenced in the Quran, the concept of 'abd' emphasizes the relationship between the servant and the divine. Historically, the name has been used across various Islamic cultures, reflecting the universal values of devotion and piety. In modern times, Obaidah remains a popular choice for Muslim parents seeking to instill a sense of spiritual identity in their children.

data.cultural_impact: The name Obaidah is of Arabic origin and is derived from the word "obaid" which translates to "one who serves, one who is a servant or helper." This name has cultural significance in the Islamic world, as helpers and servants hold a special place in Islamic teachings. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) recommended saying "Labbaik Allahumma Labbaik, Labbaik La Shareeka Laka Labbaik, Inna Al-Hamda Lil-Lahi Wa Ni'matal Waqta, Wa Minal-Lahu Wa-Lana Al-Hisab" (Here I am, O Allah, Here I am, No partner have You, Here I am, Absolutely, altogether, and from me and from them, and I will render account) when answering the call to Hajj pilgrimage. This phrase emphasizes complete submission and servitude to Allah, and reflects the importance of serving and helping one another in Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic beliefs, Obaidah, or being a servant of Allah, holds great spiritual importance. Muslims are encouraged to serve Allah through obedience to His commands, striving towards personal spiritual growth, and serving and helping others. The name reinforces the concept that every person has a role to play in the community, whether as a servant, teacher, healer, or caretaker, with the ultimate goal of serving Allah and fulfilling His purpose for us. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "None of you will believe until he loves me more than his father, his children and all mankind." (Bukhari and Muslim) This Hadith teaches us to prioritize love and devotion to Allah over all other earthly relationships, and essentially emphasizes the spiritual significance of living a life in obedience and service to Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant" symbolizes The one who serves, one who is a servant or helper.. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Obaidah serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Obaidah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Fatima Obaidah in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Obaidah, which means "Servant". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
